lessons: The only failing gate was run_record: `## Outcome` said 'implemented'. It must be exactly one closed value. Here that is `ok`. Do not copy the provider response's verdict word into run.md.

Keep the committed diff. It has the shared providers.conduct_files resolver used by both _core and CoreDrift, the AST-read branch CORE, and the CoreDrift gate in the merge regate tuple. The run reports that both verification suites passed.

Keep the run.md sections in this exact order: Outcome, Surprises / judgment calls, Dead ends, Second problems filed, Resolved engine/model, Predicted vs actual. Rerun both verification commands after editing run.md.
reason: Fixable run-record vocabulary oversight: Outcome 'implemented' is not in the closed set; the implementation itself appears complete.
